UI_Scheduler_Status_ApplyNow: Applied current hour to all survivors.

UI_Scheduler_Tooltip_Default:
Save a preset named "Default" to automatically assign its schedule to new survivors. 
Existing schedules are not affected.
UI_Scheduler_Tooltip_ApplyToAll: Replace every survivor's scheduler with the currently selected survivors schedule.
UI_Scheduler_Tooltip_ApplyNow: Immediately reapply the scheduled jobs for the current hour.
